Class JsonFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.controller.JsonFactory
public class JsonFactory extends Object
Loads game data (Characters, Events, Buildings, Tiles) from JSON resource files using Jackson polymorphic deserialization, and caches them for use by the game controller.

JSON files are expected at:

  • /json/cards.json – array of Card (polymorphic via cardType; Character uses characterType)
  • /json/buildings.json – array of Building
  • /json/tiles.json – array of Tile (polymorphic via tileType)

    • loadCards

      public List<Card> loadCards() throws IOException
      Loads all cards from cards.json. Each Card is polymorphically resolved via the "cardType" discriminator (Character, Event). Characters then use "characterType" for their own subtype.
      Returns:
      a list of Card instances.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the JSON file cannot be read or parsed.

    • loadBuildings

      public List<Building> loadBuildings() throws IOException
      Loads all buildings from buildings.json.
      Returns:
      a list of Building instances.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the JSON file cannot be read or parsed.

    • loadTiles

      public List<Tile> loadTiles() throws IOException
      Loads all offer track tiles from tiles.json.
      Returns:
      a list of Tile objects (A through G).
      Throws:
      IOException - if the JSON file cannot be read or parsed.

    • loadOrderTiles

      public List<OrderTile> loadOrderTiles() throws IOException
      Loads all order tiles from order_tiles.json. Each entry represents the turn-order tile configuration for a specific player count.
      Returns:
      a list of OrderTile objects (one per player-count setup: 2, 3, 4, 5).
      Throws:
      IOException - if the JSON file cannot be read or parsed.

    • loadConfig

      public GameConfig loadConfig() throws IOException
      Loads the game configuration from config.json.
      Returns:
      a GameConfig instance with all configuration values.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the JSON file cannot be read or parsed.
